analysis.reason: Test expected a 200 response for GET /products/1 but the API returned 404 with body {"message":"Requested item not found"}. The evidence shows the API responded correctly for a missing resource, but there is no information whether product ID 1 should exist (test data/preconditions), nor is there an independent API contract provided to determine if the test expectation is incorrect. Therefore the root cause cannot be determined from the available execution result alone.
analysis.recommendedAction: 1) Verify test data: confirm that product with ID 1 exists in the test environment or add precondition to seed it. 2) Re-run the request (e.g., curl) to reproduce and capture full response headers and body. 3) Check API documentation/contract for expected behavior for non-existent IDs. 4) If product should exist, check server logs and data store for causes of missing item (application defect). 5) If product is not guaranteed to exist, update test generation to create/seed required test data or adjust expectations.
